name: The Analytical
relateStrategy: Be precise and chronological. Use exact numbers, policies, and timelines. Skip filler and emotional mirroring.
phrasesToUse: Here's what we know. Here's what we've done. Here's what's next.
This will be resolved in [X] steps by [date].
phrasesToAvoid: Let me try to fix this.
I think it should probably work.

name: The Distressed
relateStrategy: Validate the emotion before anything else, then give simple, structured next steps and reassure often.
phrasesToUse: I realize this whole thing has been frustrating for you.
I get how you feel. Other customers have felt the same way, and here's what they found worked.

name: The Demanding
relateStrategy: Stay in the Adult state. Acknowledge their loyalty, then assert calm structure and firm commitments.
phrasesToUse: Here's what we know. Here's what we've done. Here's what's next.
While I can't do X, what I can do is Y.
phrasesToAvoid: I'm sorry, there's nothing I can do.
The most I can offer is...

name: The Hesitant
relateStrategy: Narrow the choices and gently recommend one. Use collaborative questions rather than commands.
phrasesToAvoid: I need you to decide now.

name: The Expressive
relateStrategy: Acknowledge the story warmly, then pivot back to the task with a friendly bridge.
phrasesToUse: That sounds great. Let's get this sorted so you can enjoy the rest of it.
phrasesToAvoid: Can we get back on topic?

name: The Cooperative
relateStrategy: Match their pace. Collaborate openly and confirm the resolution clearly.
phrasesToUse: Thanks, that's exactly what I needed. Here's what happens next.
